10:   // Ship definition

14:     size: 20,
15:     speed: 4,
16:     dx: 0,
17:     dy: 0,
18:     update() {

20:       this.y = Math.max(this.size, Math.min(height - this.size, this.y + this.dy));
21:     },
22:     draw() {
23:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
24:       ctx.beginPath();
25:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y - this.size);
26:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.size, this.y + this.size);
27:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.size, this.y + this.size);
28:       ctx.closePath();
29:       ctx.fill();
30:     },
31:   };
32: 
33:   // Input handling
34:   const keys = {};
35:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
36:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
37:   function handleInput() {

43:   }
44: 
45:   // Asteroid definition
46:   const asteroids = [];
47:   let asteroidTimer = 0;
48:   const spawnInterval = 2000; // ms
49:   function spawnAsteroid() {
50:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
51:     let x, y, vx, vy;
52:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
53:     if (side === 0) { // top
54:       x = Math.random() * width; y = -20; vx = (width/2 - x) / width * speed; vy = speed;
55:     } else if (side === 1) { // right
56:       x = width + 20; y = Math.random() * height; vx = -speed; vy = (height/2 - y) / height * speed;
57:     } else if (side === 2) { // bottom
58:       x = Math.random() * width; y = height + 20; vx = (width/2 - x) / width * speed; vy = -speed;
59:     } else { // left
60:       x = -20; y = Math.random() * height; vx = speed; vy = (height/2 - y) / height * speed;

63:   }
64: 
65:   function updateAsteroids(dt) {
66:     asteroidTimer += dt;
67:     if (asteroidTimer > spawnInterval) {
68:       spawnAsteroid();
69:       asteroidTimer = 0;
70:     }
71:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
72:       const a = asteroids[i];
73:       a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
74:       // Remove if off-screen
75:       if (a.x < -30 || a.x > width + 30 || a.y < -30 || a.y > height + 30) {
76:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
77:       }
78:     }
79:   }
80:

82:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';

96:         return true;
97:       }

99:     return false;
100:   }

102:   let lastTime = performance.now();
103:   let gameOver = false;
104:   let score = 0;
105:   function loop(now) {
106:     const dt = now - lastTime;
107:     lastTime = now;
108:     if (!gameOver) {
109:       handleInput();
110:       ship.update();

112:       if (checkCollision()) {
